source_documents.title: Triplet Excimer of TIPS-Anthracene in Solution

conditions_studied: solution (concentrated, with and without PtOEP sensitiser)

reference_evidence_units.quote: TA of triplet-sensitized TIPS-Ac showed a narrow photoinduced absorption (PIA) with a peak at around 700 nm.
reference_evidence_units.subject: TIPS-Ac
reference_evidence_units.statement: A new narrow PIA band appears after the isolated-triplet PIA.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The narrow PIA followed the broad PIA of an isolated triplet (T1) and is assigned to the triplet excimer excited state (T1 + S0).
reference_evidence_units.subject: TIPS-Ac
reference_evidence_units.statement: Assignment of the band to a triplet excimer (T1 + S0).

reference_evidence_units.quote: suggesting that TTA mainly proceeds with the fusion of two isolated triplets (2T1)
reference_evidence_units.subject: TIPS-Ac
reference_evidence_units.statement: Upconverted emission comes from TTA of isolated triplets, not from the excimer.
